newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bidding for Korea Telecom shrs undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Bidding for Korea Telecom shrs undersubscribed.

text.p: The South Korean Finance Ministry's auction of 500 billion won worth of Korea Telecom Corp shares was undersubscribed, with applications totalling about 139 billion won, a senior finance ministry official said on Friday.
Official results are scheduled to be announced on Saturday.
"This is not an official calculation but applications are estimated at about 139 billion won," said the official, who asked not to be named.
Only institutional investors and corporations were eligible for the November 11-12 auction.
The ministry planned to sell about 13.3 million shares of the company at 37,600 won or higher per share, the official said.
The government owns about 80 percent of Korea Telecom, which has a monopoly on the local telephone service and holds the lion's share of the long-distance service market.
